motifs.creator: Project Odisha
motifs.prompt: An original tiny book tailpiece, black pen-and-ink line art on pure white background. One slender naturally curved leafy twig, about seven simple leaves at irregular angles, horizontal gently rising composition. Quiet restrained literary book ornament, airy, fine clear black outlines, a few delicate vein strokes, almost no hatching, no heavy shaded area. Whole branch isolated, generous whitespace, no border, no text, no symbols, no landscape, no vintage paper texture. Designed to remain legible printed 4cm wide under prose in an Odia sayings book. Contemporary decorative drawing, not a historical artifact.
